metadata.description: Momentrix's single-plugin marketplace for the ICM KAP Toolkit: ICM context layers plus a Karpathy-style evidence-checked wiki, with zero runtime dependencies.

plugins.name: momentrix-icm-kap-toolkit
plugins.description: Scaffold or retrofit an ICM context layer, compile an evidence-grounded raw/ and wiki/ pair, and validate typed Orchestra workflows with deterministic views and strict preflight. Local execution and GitHub distribution use the same project repository.
